messages:
maria: Hey team — quick sync on Marketplace private-offer design for Acme SI + hardware partner. Wanted to propose an 'anchor + usage ramp' structure and confirm co-announce timing. TL;DR: 3-month frontloaded credits, 12-month commit, renewal opt-in signal 60d before renewal.

jon: Sounds good. Do we have legal ok on frontload credits? Also need to confirm metering mapping.

sara: Finance flags: frontload reduces NRR if not converted. Need min conversion SLAs. Can we gate with usage milestones?

liam: Product: we can add an entitlement meter on Marketplace SKU that scales credits after milestone events. Example ramp:
```
month1: 40% credits frontload
month2-3: 20% each
month4-12: usage-basis credits
```
Would require SI onboarding steps.

maria: @sara ok to propose 3-tier conversion SLA: 30% usage by day90, 60% by day180, else credits clawback. Thoughts?

sara: yes but need a 2-week grace and clear reporting feed. Also want a sample journal entry for accounting.

jon: Ops: will partner marketing need embargo? We should align announce on week 2 after deployment window opens. Partner prefers co-announce day 0 of GA.

liam: We should include rollover protection for customers who underuse in first year — allow 3mo rollover credits.

maria: Good. Next steps:
- @jon confirm partner marketing embargo & co-announce date
- @sara draft credit accounting flow + clawback language
- @liam add entitlement meter & SKU mapping to the marketplace listing
- @maria will draft the partner attachment and share.

deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/partners/marketplace/special-offer-draft (draft-0.1)

jon: I'll ping partner for embargo answer by EOD.

sara: I'll post sample journal by tomorrow morning.

liam: I'll put a PR for SKU mapping — need review from eng-platform.

maria: Cheers :thumbsup: Let's reconvene Thu 10am PT if anything blocks.

jon: ack

sara: ack

liam: ack
